findings.evidence: Lines 174–189 use only matrix diagonal zero divisors and `mul_eq_zero` in the source. `Mathlib/Algebra/Quaternion.lean:1112–1144` defines `NoZeroDivisors ℍ[R]` under `[CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]`; no field operation occurs.
findings.fix: At minimum weaken `Field R` to `CommRing R` and obtain `DecidableEq n` locally with `classical`; more naturally prove a generic lemma for a nontrivial no-zero-divisor algebra and derive this quaternion corollary.
findings.issue: `isEmpty_algEquiv_matrix` assumes `Field R`, although the proof only uses the no-zero-divisors property of `ℍ[R]`; Mathlib provides that already for an ordered commutative ring. `[DecidableEq n]` is also only a proof-computation requirement.

summary: The nonsplitting theorem exposes assumptions substantially stronger than its proof requires.
